Initial release of Amazon Operations Silicon Army skill.

- Provides a cross-border e-commerce Multi-Agent system for Amazon operations.
- 20 specialized agents cover the full seller workflow: product selection, listing optimization, advertising, inventory, pricing, reviews, brand, data analysis, customer service, and compliance.
- Does not require Amazon account password; supports public web data, user-uploaded data, and optional official SP-API authorization.
- IM remote scheduling and natural language command via Feishu, WeChat, WhatsApp.
- 4 prebuilt workflows (one-click new listing, ad optimization, inventory alert, customer service) and public competitive intelligence.
- Three-layer security (block/confirm/audit) for critical operations.
- Third-party integration support: Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, and ERP tools.
- Simple workflow engine, local/Python execution, and secure credential storage.
